newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start mixed, seen trading in tight range.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start mixed, seen trading in tight range.

text.p: UK shares were mixed at the opening as some investors were tempted to take profits after last Friday's record finish.
The FTSE is expected to trade in a narrow range ahead of batch of corporate results due later this week, dealers said.
"Now that the FTSE is above 4,300 people are a bit nervous. It's not too surprising that we're seeing a few people lock in some profits," the head of trading at a large investment bank said.
The FTSE 100, which jumped nearly 42 points on Friday to a record high, was down 2.2 points at 4,305.6 by 0837 GMT.
